record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.context_brief: Excluded minors for real Dowling matroids
record.original_question: What are the excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids over the real field R? A matroid is a Dowling matroid over a field F when it can be extended to an F-representable framed Dowling matroid, equivalently when it has a representation over F with at most two nonzero entries in each column.

evidence.quote: For a field F, we will call a matroid a Dowling matroid over F if it can be extended to an F-representable framed Dowling matroid or, equivalently, it admits a representation over F with at most two non-zero entries in each column.
Find the excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids over R.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let F be a field. A matroid M is called a Dowling matroid over F if it can be extended to an F-representable framed Dowling matroid; equivalently, M admits a representation over F by a matrix in which each column has at most two nonzero entries. The class of Dowling matroids over F is closed under taking minors.

Problem: Determine the complete list of excluded minors (minor-minimal matroids not in the class) for the class of Dowling matroids over the real field R.
artifact.status_search_result: No published characterization of excluded minors for Dowling matroids over R was found. Identifying excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids is recognized as an open problem in matroid structure theory, and the class of R-representable matroids itself has infinitely many excluded minors, making the Dowling case over R unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Towards a matroid-minor structure theory (Geelen-Gerards-Whittle)
status_evidence.snippet: Dowling matroids appear as fundamental building blocks in conjectured structure theorems for excluded minors of representable matroid classes.
status_evidence.claim: Excluded minors of Dowling matroid classes are studied as part of the matroid minors project and are not fully characterized.

status_evidence.title: Computing excluded minors for classes of matroids representable over partial fields
status_evidence.snippet: Computational approaches to listing excluded minors for matroid classes representable over various (partial) fields.
status_evidence.claim: Excluded minors for representability classes over fields like R are not known explicitly in general.
